family.description: This entry represents a likely zinc-binding domain found at the C-terminus of a set of archaebacterial proteins, including CdpA (Cell division protein A, HVO_0739) from Haloferax volcanii, a a ring assembly and anchor protein that forms part of an anchor complex linked to FtsZ2 and other cell division proteins. This domain plays a significant role in cell division but its specific function is currently unknown [[cite:PUB00161026]]. AlphaFold prediction show a structure forming 2-3 beta strands.
family.name: Cell division protein A, C-terminal domain
